entities.summary: Scott Thomas McGough is an American professional baseball pitcher who is a free agent. He has previously played in MLB for the Miami Marlins, Arizona Diamondbacks, and Athletics and in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Tokyo Yakult Swallows.
